note: The main banks were taken as Kosovo's three largest by assets, a choice from general knowledge (no central bank or association ranking was read in this pass): Raiffeisen Bank Kosovo, ProCredit Bank and TEB, with ProCredit's card the one reached. ProCredit Bank Kosovo: its price list for private clients (effective 13 August 2026), read again 2026-10-30. Its TOP credit card costs 20 euros a year to maintain; a balance carried on minimum payments bears 24% a year; the minimum payment is 15%. A cash withdrawal at any ATM costs 4%, at least 5 euros; currency exchange on transactions where the euro isn't used costs 2.00% of the transaction. Late payment of the minimum bears the default rate under the Central Bank of Kosovo's regulation, a reference rate published each half-year, charged only after 15 days late; it isn't written. The deferred debit card is a debit card and isn't written. Raiffeisen's and TEB's card terms weren't reached in this pass.

sources.title: ProCredit Bank Kosovo, Çmimorja për klientë privatë (effective 13 August 2026)
sources.said: Data efektive: 13.08.2026 ... Kartela e kreditit TOP Tarifat ... Mirëmbajtja vjetore e kartelës € 20.00 ... 2.00% e vlerës së transaksionit ... Norma e interesit vjetor për pagesat minimale 24% ... të bankave tjera në Kosovë dhe jashtë vendit ... 4% min € 5.00 ... Pagesa minimale 15%
